skills.name: Position, Distance, and Displacement
skills.tier_1_metric: Define scalar versus vector quantities and state the SI units for position, distance, and displacement.
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate total distance and net displacement from a given position-time data set for a moving object.

skills.name: Average and Instantaneous Speed
skills.tier_1_metric: Explain the difference between average speed and instantaneous speed using everyday examples.
skills.tier_2_metric: Compute average speed and solve for missing variables using total distance and total time elapsed.

skills.name: Average and Instantaneous Velocity
skills.tier_1_metric: Define average velocity mathematically as the change in position over change in time.
skills.tier_2_metric: Differentiate between average velocity and average speed in scenarios involving directional changes.

skills.name: Uniform Acceleration
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify the defining characteristics of motion with constant acceleration.
skills.tier_2_metric: Solve for final velocity or time given initial conditions under uniform acceleration.

skills.name: Kinematic Equations for Constant Acceleration
skills.tier_1_metric: List the four primary kinematic equations relating displacement, velocity, acceleration, and time.
skills.tier_2_metric: Select and execute the appropriate kinematic equation to solve an unknown variable in a vertical drop scenario.

skills.name: Position-Time Graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify how stationary, constant velocity, and accelerating motion appear on a position-time graph.
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate instantaneous velocity at a specific point by finding the slope of the tangent on a position-time curve.

skills.name: Velocity-Time Graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: State what the slope and the area under a velocity-time graph represent.
skills.tier_2_metric: Differentiate between periods of constant acceleration and changing acceleration by analyzing the shape of a velocity-time graph.

skills.name: Acceleration-Time Graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Define acceleration-time graph features and state the meaning of the area under the curve.
skills.tier_2_metric: Construct a velocity-time graph by analyzing and integrating data from a given acceleration-time graph.

skills.name: Interpreting Interconnected Motion Graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Match corresponding points across position-time, velocity-time, and acceleration-time graphs for simple motion.
skills.tier_2_metric: Deconstruct a complex multi-stage journey to translate a position-time graph into its corresponding velocity-time graph.

skills.name: Relative Motion Graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Explain how relative motion between two objects is represented on a shared graph.
skills.tier_2_metric: Compare two objects' motion curves on a single velocity-time graph to determine when and where they meet.

skills.name: Vector Addition and Resolution
skills.tier_1_metric: Define vector components and identify trigonometric relationships used for right-triangle resolution.
skills.tier_2_metric: Resolve a 2D displacement vector into its orthogonal x and y components using sine and cosine.

skills.name: Projectile Motion Principles
skills.tier_1_metric: State the independence of horizontal and vertical motions in projectile problems.
skills.tier_2_metric: Deconstruct a projectile's initial velocity into horizontal and vertical components for problem-solving.

skills.name: Horizontal Projectiles
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify initial conditions and assumptions for an object launched horizontally off a cliff.
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate the time of flight and range of a horizontally launched projectile.

skills.name: Angled Projectiles
skills.tier_1_metric: Define maximum height, time of flight, and range in the context of symmetric projectile motion.
skills.tier_2_metric: Solve for the maximum height and total horizontal range of a projectile launched at an angle above the horizontal.

skills.name: Relative Velocity in 2D
skills.tier_1_metric: Explain the concept of relative velocity using reference frames (e.g., boat crossing a river or wind affecting a plane).
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate the resultant velocity vector of a moving body relative to the ground given crosswinds or currents.
